Thank you for telling us the new logo does not match your brief for Coastal Pet Grooming. We take that seriously and are not sending you a payment reminder right now. The owner of Harbor Lane Web Studio will review your original brief alongside the delivered logo and contact you directly to talk through what needs to change. We want you to end up with a logo you are happy to use.

Best regards,
Harbor Lane Web Studio", "invoice_note": "On hold: logo redesign under review with the customer; no payment requested until resolved."}
